matching_policies.excerpt: This manual serves as a comprehensive guide for managing risks and ensuring compliance within SecureLife Insurance Ltd., a leading insurance provider in India. Established in 2005, SecureLife is committed to delivering innovative insurance solutions while maintaining robust risk management and compliance frameworks. The manual outlines the policies, procedures, and frameworks necessary to align with IRDAI regulations and industry best practices. It is intended to be used by the Board of Directors, management, and employees to foster a culture of risk awareness and compliance. By implementing the guidelines in this manual, SecureLife aims to enhance its operational resilience, maintain regulatory compliance, and achieve its strategic objectives of increasing market share by 15% annually over the next five years. This document will be reviewed and updated annually to ensure it remains aligned with the evolving business environment and regulatory landscape.

This Agreement applies only to the issuance of insurance by the Company or, as allowed in Article V Changes to Business Reinsured, its affiliate companies, in a jurisdiction in which the issuing company is properly licensed.
